executionModel.cash: 1 - sum(weights); residual may exceed one or be negative for shorts/leverage.
executionModel.decision: Target weights use bars through close t; previous targets earn (t-1,t].
executionModel.fills: Synthetic daily target allocations, not broker orders or fills; financing/borrow costs omitted.
executionModel.rebalanceTurnover: Sum(abs(target[t] - target[t-1]*(1+assetReturn[t])/(1+grossReturn[t]))); one-way risky notional at close t after returns, divided by pre-trade equity.
executionModel.return: Sum of previous target weight times each asset close-to-close return; cash return is zero.
executionModel.targetChange: Sum(abs(target[t] - target[t-1])); changes in rule targets only.
executionModel.wfo: Candidate retains its own hypothetical state; first test return uses previous published target.

git.note: Content hashes identify the executed files even when the working tree is dirty.

reason.candidateState: Selected candidate's own hypothetical historical state
reason.text: Candidate action: remain-flat. Enter below the Connors RSI threshold; exit above the exit threshold or at the maximum holding days.

reproduction.guarantee: Standard-library arithmetic replay to 1e-10; archived-source recomputation requires matching private inputs and dependencies.
reproduction.warning: Original provider inputs are not public. Revised input hashes cannot claim exact recomputation. Execute archived source only if you trust its author.
